title: Embed & Rerank Endpoint Visibility Playbook — KPIs, Traces, and Cost Attribution
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a reproducible, low-noise observability surface for embeddings and rerank endpoints that answers: 1) Which customer routes drive unit cost? 2) Where are latency hotspots (tokenization, embedding forward, rerank scoring, post-processing)? 3) Is model quality changing (MRR/NDCG) or degrading for a route? Deliverables: per-endpoint dashboards, distributed tracing spans and sampling, cost-per-request attribution, automated alerts for SLO and quality regressions, and a short runbook for incident response.
acceptance_criteria: Per-endpoint dashboard exists in Grafana/Console for every public embedding and rerank route showing P50/P95 latency, batching efficiency, cache hit rate, and per-request token cost

Tracing: all embedding/rerank requests produce a trace with spans for client-request, tokenization, embedding-inference, batching-wait, rerank-scoring, and storage-access; sampling defaults to 1% with dynamic bump for errors
Cost attribution: cost-per-request calculated and visible (GPU-time-based estimate + infra overhead) and broken down by model variant and batch size
Quality metrics: nightly evaluation pipeline computes route-level MRR@10, NDCG@10 and drift score; alerts trigger when MRR drops >5% or NDCG drops >4% relative to a rolling baseline
Alerting rules and runbook created: latency SLO (P95 < 500ms for rerank light routes, < 200ms for embeddings), error rate threshold, and quality regression alerts with on-call escalation steps
tasks: Instrument embedding and rerank handlers with explicit spans (tokenize, model_infer, score, postproc)
Add route metadata tags to traces (route_id, customer_id_hash, model_id, batch_size, fallback_used)
Emit cost-related metrics: gpu_ms, cpu_ms, memory_bytes, kv_cache_hits, token_count
Create Grafana/Console dashboards and templates for 'endpoint overview', 'cost breakdown', and 'quality trends'
Implement nightly eval job for route-level MRR/NDCG and store results in metricsDB
Define and implement alert rules in PagerDuty with automatic context links to traces and last 100 request samples
Backfill 90 days of aggregated metrics for a selected pilot set (10 high-traffic routes)
decisions: Sampling: default 1% trace sampling; increase to 10% for routes exceeding error-rate threshold or significant latency regressions
Cost attribution model: use GPU-ms * instance-cost-per-ms as primary signal, fall back to token-based estimate for CPU-only paths
Quality telemetry: do not log full request content; only store hashed context IDs and anonymized evaluation IDs for privacy compliance
Dashboard hosting: prefer Redwood Console dashboards for routing into runbooks and customer overlays, Grafana for lower-level operational panels
blockers: Finalized cost-per-GPU-ms numbers from finance (ticket FIN-1120) needed to compute accurate cost-per-request
Kubernetes node-level GPU metrics require cluster role tweak (ops ticket OPS-807) before reliable gpu_ms can be computed
Agreement on retention for sampled traces (security policy review pending)
